## Objective
The objective of this model is to identify regions of small intestinal mucosa 
in tissue fragments. 

### Issues
If no si mucosa > 100% it gets filtered out completely - I want to keep it but labelled no_si_mucosa I think
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)

fragment_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/"
combos_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/combos/"
output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/"

#Read tuning set
subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_tuning.json")


#read fragment list
fragment_list <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/validate_fragments/corrected_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.json") %>%
  filter(classification == "included_fragment")

image_names <- unique(fragment_list$image_name)

image_fragment_names <- paste(fragment_list$image_name, fragment_list$fragment_name, sep = "_")


#Filter on have ia results
layer_files <- list.files(combos_dir)
#filter for files with layers file
matching_image_fragment_names <- image_fragment_names[ sapply(image_fragment_names, function(name) {
  any(startsWith(layer_files, name))
}) ]

templates_all  <- NULL

for (image_fragment in matching_image_fragment_names[465:828]){
  
  split_matrix <- str_split_fixed(image_fragment, "_", 2)
  img <- split_matrix[, 1]
  frag<- split_matrix[, 2]
  
  image_metadata <- subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning %>% filter(image_name == img)
  pixel_area_um2 <- image_metadata$pixel_area_um2
  pixel_length_um <- image_metadata$pixel_length_um
  
  layer_path <- paste0(combos_dir, image_fragment, "_layers.geojson")
  
  layers <- st_read(layer_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_set_crs(0) 
  
  
  
  if (nrow(layers) == 0) {
    
    fragment_path <- paste0(fragment_dir, img, "_fragments.geojson")
    si_mucosa <- st_read(fragment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0)%>%
      filter(name == frag) %>%
      rename(fragment_name = name) %>%
      mutate(mucosa_name = "00",
             name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep="_"),
             classification = "no_si_mucosa",
             area_1000_um2 = fragment_area_um2 / 1000) %>%
      select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, area_1000_um2, geometry)
    
    } else {
  
      si_mucosa <- layers %>%
        group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked) %>%
        mutate(confidence_percentage = round(confidence_percentage)) %>%
        filter(confidence_percentage == 100) %>%
        summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
        st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(
          classification = "si_mucosa",
          area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
          area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
          area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000) %>%
        filter(area_1000_um2 > 100) %>%
        mutate(
          mucosa_name = str_pad(rank(-area_px2, 
                                     ties.method = "first"), 
                                width = 2, 
                                pad = "0"),
          name = paste(img, frag, mucosa_name, sep = "_")) %>%
        select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, area_1000_um2)
    
    }
  
  st_write(si_mucosa, paste0(output_dir, image_fragment, "_si_mucosa.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  
  template <- si_mucosa %>% st_drop_geometry()
  
  templates_all <- bind_rows(templates_all, template)
    
}



```

```{r}
templates_all <- templates_all %>%
  left_join(fragment_list_comment)

write_xlsx(templates_all, paste0(output_dir, "templates_si_mucosa.xlsx"))
```

## Input
-*<image_name>_fragments.geojson*
-*image_name>_<fragment_name>_layers.geojson*

## Output
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_<mucosa_name>_si_mucosa_orientation.geojson*

## Parameters
The thresholds were set by examining proportions in fragments in the tuning set. 

Performance was evauluate by inspecting the tuning set (only incorrect labels documented) and documented here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yd_yRu5BlewXfkpWqm7iU-oXL4VxJQcVr0TTOBoNTPY/edit?usp=sharing
with examples here: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1DXAzfuI3s2T7yXSY5XOSxSZTdDFm8SWEf1zP4o9WkXU/edit?usp=sharing

## Issues /Comments / Deviations
- This leverages the layers model (crypts vs villi) and is not designed to differentiate small intestine from other tissues. The hope is however that other tissues would generally fall in the "inadequate" category and be able to be filtered out with that prior to further processing.
- 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)

subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning.json")

image_names <- subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning$image_name


fragment_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/"
layers_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/combos/"
output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa_orientation/"

layer_files <- list.files(layers_dir)
#filter for files with layers file
matching_image_names <- image_names[ sapply(image_names, function(name) {
  any(startsWith(layer_files, name))
}) ]

si_mucosa_template <- NULL
for (image in matching_image_names){
  
  image_metadata <- subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning %>% filter(image_name == image)
  pixel_area_um2 <- image_metadata$pixel_area_um2
  pixel_length_um <- image_metadata$pixel_length_um
  
  fragment_path <- paste0(fragment_dir, image, "_fragments.geojson")
  fragments <- st_read(fragment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_set_crs(0) %>%
    filter(classification == "included_fragment") %>%
    select(id:name, geometry)
  
  fragment_names <- fragments$name
  
  for (frag in fragment_names){
    
    fragment <- fragments %>% filter(name == frag) %>%
      mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
             area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2)
    
    fragment_area_um2 <- fragment$area_um2

    
    layer_path <- paste0(layers_dir,image, "_", frag, "_layers.geojson")
    
  
    layers <- st_read(layer_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0) 
    
    if (nrow(layers) == 0) {
      si_mucosa <- data.frame(
        image_name = character(), 
        fragment_name = character(), 
        name = character(), 
        classification = character(),
        area_1000_um2 = numeric(), 
        pct_high_confidence_villi = numeric(), 
        pct_high_confidence_crypts = numeric())
    } else {
      
      si_mucosa <- layers %>%
        group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked) %>%
        mutate(confidence_percentage = round(confidence_percentage)) %>%
        summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
        st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(
          area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
          area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
          area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000) %>%
        filter(area_1000_um2 > 100) %>%
        mutate(
          mucosa_name = str_pad(rank(-area_px2, 
                                     ties.method = "first"), 
                                width = 2, 
                                pad = "0"),
          name = paste("fragment", frag, "mucosa", mucosa_name, sep = "_")) 
    
    intersection_df <- layers %>%
      mutate(confidence_percentage = round(confidence_percentage)) %>%
      select(classification, confidence_percentage, geometry) %>%
      st_intersection(si_mucosa %>% select(name, geometry)) %>%
      mutate(area_intersect_px2 = st_area(geometry),
             area_intersect_um2 = area_intersect_px2 * pixel_area_um2)
    
    summary_stats <- intersection_df %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      group_by(name) %>%
      summarise(
        total_area = sum(area_intersect_um2),
        villi_area = sum(area_intersect_um2[classification == "villi"], na.rm = TRUE),
        crypt_area = sum(area_intersect_um2[classification == "crypts"], na.rm = TRUE),
        villi_area_high_confidence = sum(area_intersect_um2[classification == "villi" & confidence_percentage == 100], na.rm = TRUE),
        crypt_area_high_confidence = sum(area_intersect_um2[classification == "crypts" & confidence_percentage == 100], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(
        pct_high_confidence_villi = ifelse(villi_area > 0, (villi_area_high_confidence /
                                                      total_area) * 100, 0),
        pct_high_confidence_crypts = ifelse(crypt_area > 0, (crypt_area_high_confidence /
                                                       total_area) * 100, 0)
        ) %>%
      select(name, pct_high_confidence_villi, pct_high_confidence_crypts)
    
    si_mucosa <- si_mucosa %>%
      left_join(summary_stats, by = "name") %>%
      mutate(
             classification = case_when(
               pct_high_confidence_villi < 15 ~ "inadequate_orientation",
               pct_high_confidence_crypts < 15 ~ "inadequate_orientation",
               TRUE ~ "included_si_mucosa")) %>%
      select(image_name, fragment_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked, area_1000_um2, pct_high_confidence_villi, pct_high_confidence_crypts)
    
    st_write(si_mucosa, paste0(output_dir, image, "_", frag, "_si_mucosa.geojson"), 
             quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
    }
    
    template <- si_mucosa %>% 
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(image_name, fragment_name, name, classification, area_1000_um2, pct_high_confidence_villi, pct_high_confidence_crypts)
    
    si_mucosa_template <- bind_rows(si_mucosa_template, template)
  
    
    }
}

si_mucosa_template <- si_mucosa_template %>%
  mutate(image_name_order = match(image_name, unique(image_name))) %>%
  arrange(image_name_order, name) %>%
  select(-image_name_order)

write_xlsx(si_mucosa_template, paste0(output_dir, "si_mucosa_template.xlsx"))
```


### assess
```{r}
subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning.json")

image_names <- subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning$image_name


fragment_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/"
layers_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/process_combos/"
output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/"

layer_files <- list.files(layers_dir)
#filter for files with layers file
matching_image_names <- image_names[ sapply(image_names, function(name) {
  any(startsWith(layer_files, name))
}) ]





reviewed <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/input/si_mucosa_reviewed_3.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(confusion_matrix = 
           case_when((classification == "included_si_mucosa" & is.na(correction)) ~ "TP",
                  (classification != "included_si_mucosa" & is.na(correction)) ~ "TN",
                  (classification == "included_si_mucosa" & correction == "FP") ~ "FP",
                  classification != "included_si_mucosa" & correction == "FN" ~ "FN",
                  TRUE ~ NA))

# Count each confusion matrix category
conf_counts <- table(reviewed$confusion_matrix)

TP <- conf_counts["TP"]
TN <- conf_counts["TN"]
FP <- conf_counts["FP"]
FN <- conf_counts["FN"]

# Replace NA with 0 if any of these are missing
TP <- ifelse(is.na(TP), 0, TP)
TN <- ifelse(is.na(TN), 0, TN)
FP <- ifelse(is.na(FP), 0, FP)
FN <- ifelse(is.na(FN), 0, FN)

# Metrics
sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)
ppv <- TP / (TP + FP)  # Positive Predictive Value (Precision)
accuracy <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
balanced_accuracy <- (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
f1_score <- 2 * (ppv * sensitivity) / (ppv + sensitivity)

# Combine into a data frame for viewing
metrics <- data.frame(
  Sensitivity = sensitivity,
  Specificity = specificity,
  PPV = ppv,
  Accuracy = accuracy,
  Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
  F1_Score = f1_score
)
                      
```

```{r}
layers_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/combos/"
mucosa_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/"

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/orientation/"

included <- reviewed %>% filter(classification == "included_si_mucosa") %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_"))

subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning_included <- subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning %>%
  filter(image_name %in% included$image_name) %>% 
  select(image_name, pixel_length_um, pixel_area_um2)

# Merge the dataframes by image_name, keeping all rows from 'included'
merged_df <- included %>%
  left_join(subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning_included, by = "image_name") %>%
  # Arrange to keep the order of image_name as in subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning_included
  mutate(image_name = factor(image_name, levels = unique(subset_fe_si_layers_pv6_tuning_included$image_name))) %>%
  arrange(image_name, name) %>%
  mutate(mucosa_name = str_extract(name, "\\d+$"),
         image_fragment_mucosa_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(image_fragment_mucosa_name, image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, pixel_length_um, pixel_area_um2, area_1000_um2, confusion_matrix, comment)

image_fragment_mucosa_names <- merged_df$image_fragment_mucosa_name 

templates_all <- NULL

for (img_frag_muc in image_fragment_mucosa_names){
  
  mucosa_name <- str_extract(img_frag_muc, "\\d+$")
  
  meta <- merged_df %>% filter(image_fragment_mucosa_name == img_frag_muc)
  
  image_fragment_name <- paste(meta$image_name, meta$fragment_name, sep = "_")
  
  mucosa_path <- paste0(mucosa_dir, image_fragment_name, "_si_mucosa.geojson")
  layers_path <- paste0(layers_dir, image_fragment_name, "_layers.geojson")
  
  mucosa_frag <- st_read(mucosa_path) %>%
    st_set_crs(0)
  
  layers_frag <- st_read(layers_path) %>%
    st_set_crs(0)
  
  layers_united<- layers_frag %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked, classification) %>%
    summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry, .groups = "drop"))
  
  villi <- layers_united  %>%
      filter(classification == "villi") 
  
  crypts <- layers_united  %>%
      filter(classification == "crypts") 
  
  mucosa_part <- mucosa_frag %>% filter(name == meta$name)
  
  mucosa_geom <- mucosa_part %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  villi_intersection <- st_intersection(villi, mucosa_geom) %>%
    mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
           area_um2 = area_px2 * meta$pixel_area_um2,
           area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
           circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
  
  crypts_intersection <- st_intersection(crypts, mucosa_geom) %>%
    mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
           area_um2 = area_px2 * meta$pixel_area_um2,
           area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
           circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
  
  shared_border <- st_intersection(st_boundary(villi_intersection), st_boundary(crypts_intersection))
  
  length_shared_border_px <- st_length(shared_border)
  
  villi_part <- villi_intersection %>%
    mutate(pct_shared_border = (length_shared_border_px / circumference_px) * 100)
  
  crypts_part <- crypts_intersection %>%
    mutate(pct_shared_border = (length_shared_border_px / circumference_px) * 100)
  
  layers_mucosa_part <- bind_rows(villi_part, crypts_part)
  
  mucosa_partial <- mucosa_part %>%
    mutate(pct_villi =  (villi_part$area_1000_um2 / area_1000_um2) * 100,
           pct_crypts =  (crypts_part$area_1000_um2 / area_1000_um2) * 100,
           pct_shared_border_villi = villi_part$pct_shared_border,
           pct_shared_border_crypts = crypts_part$pct_shared_border,
           mucosa_name = mucosa_name, 
           classification = case_when(
             pct_villi > 40 & pct_crypts > 40 & pct_shared_border_villi > 40 & 
               pct_shared_border_crypts > 40 ~ "excellent_orientation",
             pct_villi > 30 & pct_crypts > 30 & pct_shared_border_villi > 30 & pct_shared_border_crypts > 30 &
        !(pct_villi > 40 & pct_crypts > 40 & pct_shared_border_villi > 40 & pct_shared_border_crypts > 40) ~ "adequate_orientation",
        pct_villi > 10 & pct_crypts > 10 & pct_shared_border_villi > 10 & pct_shared_border_crypts > 10 &
        !(pct_villi > 30 & pct_crypts > 30 & pct_shared_border_villi > 30 & pct_shared_border_crypts > 30) ~
          "marginal_orientation",
        pct_villi <= 10 | pct_crypts <= 10 | pct_shared_border_villi <= 10 | pct_shared_border_crypts <= 10 ~ "inadequate_orientation",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  
  st_write(mucosa_partial, paste0(output_dir, img_frag_muc, "_orientation.geojson"),
           quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  
  template <- mucosa_partial%>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(image_name, 
           fragment_name, 
           mucosa_name,
           area_1000_um2, 
           pct_villi, 
           pct_crypts, 
           pct_shared_border_villi, 
           pct_shared_border_crypts,
           classification)
  
  templates_all <- bind_rows(templates_all, template)
}

  
  
  
  

write_xlsx(templates_all, paste0(output_dir, "_orientation_template.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
included <- reviewed %>% filter(classification == "included_si_mucosa") %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_"))

included_image_fragment_names <- unique(included$image_fragment_name)

for (frag in included_image_fragment_names[11]){
 
  layers_path <- paste0(layers_dir, frag, "_layers.geojson")
  
  layers <- st_read(layers_path) %>%
    st_set_crs(0)
  
  layers_united <- layers %>%
    group_by(classification) %>%
    summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry, .groups = "drop"))
  
  villi_geom <- layers_united  %>%
      filter(classification == "villi") %>%
      pull(geometry)
  
  crypts_geom <- layers_united  %>%
      filter(classification == "crypts") %>%
      pull(geometry)
  
  image_name <- layers$image_name
  fragment_name <- layers$fragment_name
  
  
  mucosa_path <- paste0(mucosa_dir, frag, "_si_mucosa.geojson")
  
  mucosa <- st_read(mucosa_path) %>%
    st_set_crs(0)
  
  mucosa_names <- mucosa$name
  
  for (mucosa_name in mucosa_names){
    
    mucosa_part <- mucosa %>% filter(name == mucosa_name)
    
    villi_intersection <- st_intersection(villi_geom, mucosa_part) %>%
      st_union()
    
  
    
    villi_mucosa_part <- st_sf(
      image_name = image_name, 
      fragment_name = fragment_name,
      mucosa_name = mucosa_name,
      classification = "villi",
      geometry = villi_intersection
    )
    crypts_intersection <- st_intersection(crypts_geom, mucosa_part) 
    
    crypts_intersect_geom <- st_union(crypts_intersection)
    
    crypts_mucosa_part <- st_sf(
      image_name = image_name, 
      fragment_name = fragment_name,
      mucosa_name = mucosa_name,
      classification = "crypts",
      geometry = crypts_intersection
    )
    
    layers_mucosa_part <- bind_rows(villi_mucosa_part, crypts_mucosa_part)
  
    
    
    
  }
  
  intersect_list <- list()
  
  for (layer_class in unique(layers$classification)) {
    layer_geom <- layers  %>%
      filter(classification == layer_class) %>%
      pull(geometry)
    
    intersect_geom <- st_sfc(crs = st_crs(mucosa))
    
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(mucosa))) {
      mucosa_part <- mucosa[i]
      
      current_mucosa_geom <- mucosa$geometry[i]
      intersection <- st_intersection(layer_geom, current_mucosa_geom)
      
      if (length(intersection) > 0) {
        
        intersect_geom <- c(intersect_geom, intersection)
      }
    }
    
    intersect_geom <- st_union(intersect_geom)
    
    intersect_list[[layer_class]] <- st_sf(
      classification = layer_class,
      geometry = intersect_geom
    )
  }
  
  layers_mucosa <- bind_rows(intersect_list)
  
  geom_villi <- layers_mucosa %>% filter(classification == "villi") %>% pull(geometry)
  
  geom_crypts <- layers_mucosa %>% filter(classification == "crypts") %>% pull(geometry)
  
  shared_border <- st_intersection(st_boundary(geom_villi), st_boundary(geom_crypts))
  
  length_shared_border <- st_length(shared_border) %>% sum()
  circumference_villi <- st_length(st_boundary(geom_villi)) %>% sum()
  
  circumference_crypts <- st_length(st_boundary(geom_crypts)) %>% sum()
  
  pct_shared_border_of_villi_circ <- as.numeric(length_shared_border / circumference_villi) * 100
  
  pct_shared_border_of_crypts_circ <- as.numeric(length_shared_border / circumference_crypts) * 100
  
  
  

  
  
  
  
}

```
